{{Quote|We were able to suppress reports of what happened on Kaon. Lorrick doesn't know we're on to him. If we strike at his base now, we'll catch him off guard. Put an end to his experiments before he unleashes another outbreak on the galaxy.|[[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Rannos]]|<ref name="Tion Hegemony Rep" />}}
During the [[Galactic War]], a '''mission''' to the [[Lost Island]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], was undertook by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] in order to eliminate [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Sannus Lorrick]] who was responsible for the [[Tion Hegemony rakghoul outbreak]].<ref name="Lost Island" />

==Prelude==
After an unprecedented [[Rakghoul]] [[Tion Hegemony rakghoul outbreak|outbreak]] on [[Kaon]], agents of both the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] sent to the planet to investigate, discovered that [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Sannus Lorrick]] was responsible for the catastrophe. From information provided by a smuggler [[Melarra]] who used to work for Sannus, both galactic powers were able to locate his secret research facility on an [[island]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]],<ref name="Kaon">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|Kaon Under Siege}}</ref> known as "[[Lost Island|the Lost Island]]". To deal with the mad scientist and secure his research, strike teams were assembled aboard [[Ziost Shadow]] of the Imperial fleet and [[Gav Daragon (Valor-class)|Gav Daragon]] of the Republic fleet. In getting to Ord Mantell, the Republic team took the services of a pilot [[Ulla]].<ref name="Lost Island" />

At the same time, scientists from [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Sannus Lorrick|Sannus]]'s team attempted to destroy his laboratory from within, and managed to sabotage his research files. Sannus dealt with insubordination by infecting his colleagues with the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|Rakghoul plague]], turning them into loyal mindless [[Rakghoul|monsters]].<ref name="Lost Island" />

==Battle==
{{Quote|Butchers! Trespassers! How dare you come into my lab and slaughter my children!|Doctor Sannus Lorrick|<ref name="Lost Island" />}}
Using [[Plug-6 heavy fighter]]s to covertly enter the [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]'s airspace, strike teams made their way to the island and landed on a [[Beach/Legends|beach]] to the south from the main compound. The island was overrun with various animals, primarily [[razoronn]]s, [[Mantellian flutterplume/Legends|flutterplumes]] and [[shaclaw]]s, infected with [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|Rakghoul plague]], which was perfected by Doctor [[Sannus Lorrick|Sannus]] to be transmitted between different species. After clearing the approach, strike teams entered the compound.<ref name="Lost Island" />
[[File:Project Sav-Rak.png|left|thumb|235x235px|Project "Sav-Rak"]]
Navigating their way through the facility, strike teams encountered dozens of fully transformed [[Rakghoul|Rakghouls]]. The logs stored in the databanks of the research center revealed that [[Sannus Lorrick|Sannus]] fooled his team into believing that they were searching for a cure, while in reality developed the deadliest version of the plague instead. Advancing through the compound was especially hardened by several mutated creatures - experiments set loose to destroy the intruders. These included [[Mantellian Savrip|savrips]] [[project Sav-Rak|project "Sav-Rak"]] and "[[Rockchewer]]", a [[Reek/Legends|reek]] referred to as a "[[Transgenic Sample Seven|transgenic sample seven]]" and a [[vorantikus]] referred to as a "[[Transgenic Sample Eleven|transgenic sample eleven]]".<ref name="Lost Island" />

Having dealt with the monstrosities, strike teams were finally able to access the main research lab in which [[Doctor/Legends|Dcotor]] [[Sannus Lorrick]], the last [[Human/Legends|Human]] of his now turned into [[Rakghoul|Rakghouls]] scientific team, was preparing for a fight. Before the confrontation, he injected himself with the last version of the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|plague]], which temporally amplified his strength and agility. Together with his Rakghoul servants - once his colleagues - he met infiltrators in battle, attempting to poison his foes with various bio-chemical weapons. Mid-fight, the injection he gave himself transformed his body completely, turning the Human doctor into a large Rakghoul beast. In this state he was killed.<ref name="Lost Island" />

==Outcome==
Despite the research data from the facility on [[Lost Island]] being sabotaged by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Sannus Lorrick|Sannus]]'s colleagues, proving unsalvageable for future study, both galactic super-powers engaged in the battle claimed victory, believing to have avoided the danger of the total [[Rakghoul]] outbreak.<ref name="Lost Island" /> Unknowingly to them, however, ships carrying the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|plague]] have been already dispatched to various planets outside [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]]. Their arrival to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] would cause a galactic-wide [[Rakghoul pandemic]], continuing the legacy of the mad scientist.<ref name="Codex 5" />

==Behind the scenes==
This article represents the events of a Flashpoint mission "Lost Island" from the [[2012]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', available to both Republic and Imperial players. Despite initially having different goals, both factions achieve the same outcome by the end of the mission.<ref name="Lost Island" />
